name: dongle
description: Connecting the Quest 3 directly with ethernet

blocks.text: **__Using a USB Dongle/Adapter on your Meta Quest__**

While it's technically **unsupported by Meta**, it is possible to use a USB to Ethernet adapter or hub attached to your Quest 3 headset.

There are a few conditions that must be met:
1. This is a not officially supported feature and can be removed by Meta at any time. (Meta removed this feature from the Quest 2 and the Quest 3 in the past)
2. Many USB to Ethernet devices simply will not work. You'll need to research which ones will work.
3. Developer mode and an adb command from a connected PC is required to make this work with the Quest 2 and Quest Pro `adb shell setprop debug.usb.ethernet.enabled 1`
4. The headset will give you no indication that it's using the Ethernet connection other than that it simply works.
5. **Meta will not provide support for this feature. **
